name: data ownership persistence steward
rules: Assign each authoritative data set to one explicit owner and define access through contracts.
Keep projections, replicas and derived views distinguishable from the source of truth.
Block direct cross-boundary persistence coupling and preserve consistency and provenance semantics.
verification: Review owned and non-owned data, write authority and cross-boundary access paths.
Verify persistence and projection tests cover identity, consistency, failure and recovery behavior.
